description: Vercel AI SDK generateText call. The outer span is a chain and the doGenerate child is the LLM span, so tokens and cost are recorded once.
notes: ai.settings.maxRetries becomes request_params {"maxRetries":2} on the chain. ai.response.text stays plain text on the chain and becomes an assistant message on doGenerate. ai.telemetry.metadata.sessionId and userId fill context fields and are not copied into metadata.
